desc: The Spyderco UpTern, inspired by the design of the non-locking byrd Tern, strikes an exceptional balance of convenience, cutting performance. A proud member of their Value Folder family, it features a full-flat-ground 8Cr13MoV stainless steel blade, a textured forefinger choil and thumb ramp, a satin-finished stainless steel handle, a sturdy back lock mechanism, and a fully configurable four-position pocket clip. The perfect canvas for engraving and other aftermarket embellishment, the UpTern combines affordability with classic old-school Spyderco craftsmanship.
